Support

Need Help?

We’re here to help you with questions or issues related to the app. The app is designed for private conversations within closed communities such as families, friends, households, and business teams. There is no public account search or user discovery. You can connect with someone only if you know their nickname.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I create an account?

Getting started is simple. Choose your nickname and follow the instructions in the app. No complicated registration process is required.

How do I add a contact?

To contact another user, you need to know their nickname. Enter their nickname to send a contact request.

The other user can accept or decline your request before a conversation begins.

Can I search for people?

No. The app does not provide public account search or user discovery.

It is designed for communication with people you already know.

What can I send?

You can:

  • Send text messages
  • Send voice messages
  • Share photos
  • Share videos
  • Use speech-to-text

How do I block someone?

If you no longer want to communicate with a user, you can add them to your blacklist from within the app. This prevents unwanted communication.

How do I report a user or inappropriate content?

Use the Report option available in the app to report inappropriate content or user behavior.

Reports are reviewed, and appropriate action may be taken when content or behavior violates our rules.

How do I protect my nickname?

Share your nickname only with people you want to communicate with. Because the app does not provide public user search, other users generally need to know your nickname to send you a contact request.

Contact Support

If you experience a technical problem, have a question, or need assistance with a report, please contact our support team.

When reporting a technical issue, please include:

  • A short description of the problem
  • Your device model
  • Your operating system version
  • The app version
  • Steps that reproduce the problem
